room.title: Emotion Wiki
room.intro: This page is based on Ekman's six basic emotions: joy, sadness, anger, fear, surprise, and disgust.
room.subtitle: Emotions aren't good or bad — sometimes we feel more than one at once.
room.ending: There are so many emotions — more emotion stars are slowly being born in the universe. Stay tuned ✦

joy.name: Joy
joy.description: Joy often shows up when things go well, when you feel understood, or when you feel accompanied.

sad.name: Sadness
sad.description: You may feel sad when you experience loss, being ignored, or getting hurt.

anger.name: Anger
anger.description: Anger tends to appear when your boundaries are crossed or something feels unfair.

fear.name: Fear
fear.description: Fear arises when facing the unknown or under pressure.

surprise.name: Surprise
surprise.description: You feel surprised when something unexpected happens.

disgust.name: Disgust
disgust.description: Disgust shows up when you encounter something uncomfortable or repulsive.

about.heroSubtitle: An interactive site that combines SEL with visualization to help you understand emotions and express feelings
about.introLead1: Emotion Universe is an interactive site built around
about.introLeadStrong2: visual design to help users understand their own and others' emotions
about.introBody1: Through emotion monsters, an anonymous sharing mechanism, and a universe-style interactive scene, the site helps children explore their inner feelings, express emotions, and naturally practice understanding, empathy, and connection while viewing others' stories.
about.introHighlightPre: We hope this is more than just a mood-journaling tool — we hope it's a
about.introHighlightStrong: digital emotional-learning space where children can safely feel their own emotions and learn to understand others
about.conceptBody1Pre: Social and Emotional Learning (SEL) is an educational approach focused on children's
about.conceptBody1Mid: . Proposed by CASEL (the Collaborative for Academic, Social, and Emotional Learning) in the US, it is a form of emotional education that includes
about.conceptBody1Strong2: understanding one's own and others' emotions, managing stress, empathy, and social skills
about.conceptBody2Pre: Through mood journaling, anonymous sharing, and interacting with the Emotion Universe, we hope children can gradually build emotional understanding and social skills through natural participation, so that
about.conceptBody2Strong: emotional education isn't just explained, but seen, felt, and practiced
about.featuresIntro: Every feature below is designed around SEL concepts, so children can naturally practice understanding and expressing emotions through interaction.
about.featuresNote: ✦ Note: this site currently runs on a free cloud server, so the first submission or the first action after being idle may take a few seconds — this is expected.
about.feature1Text: Anonymous mood logging and sharing, kept for 24 hours or forever in the public universe.
about.feature2Text: Emotions presented as cards, helping you understand different feelings visually.
about.feature3Text: Browse others' emotions interactively. Users can choose to keep their emotion stars for 24 hours or forever.
about.feature4Text: Your mood journal is analyzed with NLP, then answered with an AI-generated response.
about.tech1Line1: Built the page structure with the App Router
about.tech1Line2: Managed interactive state with React hooks (useState / useEffect)
about.tech1Line3: Responsible for the frontend UI and connecting it to the backend API
about.tech2Line1: Built API endpoints such as /moods and /reply
about.tech2Line2: Handled mood data and reply logic
about.tech2Line3: Acted as the service layer between the frontend and the database
about.tech3Line1: Designed the basic table structure for mood data
about.tech3Line3: Configured data retention and display rules as needed
about.tech4Line2: Determines emotion, topic, need, and intensity fields
about.tech4Line3: Doesn't rely on any paid external API
about.tech5Line1: Designed characters and star visuals from scratch
about.tech5Line2: Built CSS animations (e.g. floating, envelope interaction)
about.tech5Line3: Integrated visual design with frontend implementation
about.tech6Line3: Frontend connects to cloud APIs and cloud data services
about.impactTitle: The Impact We Hope to Make
about.impactBody1: In Emotion Universe, every emotion is like a star in the universe — deserving to be seen and understood.
about.impactBody2: We hope children in this space learn not only to say "here's how I feel right now", but also gradually understand that "others feel differently too", building deeper self-understanding, empathy, and the ability to express emotions.
about.contactBody: We care about your experience — please reach out if you run into any issues.
